connectors.always_hint: When this is on, the agent gets this connector's tools with every message. When it is off, ChatVia.ai uses smart tool discovery to pick only the tools each message needs. Always on works well when you have only a few connectors. If you have many, turn it off and let smart tool discovery choose. Sending too many tools makes replies slower and the agent more likely to pick the wrong one.
